inventory_method: AST enumeration of @alex_tool registrations; inventory is not behavioral coverage

tools.name: log_expense
tools.description: Record an expense or income. MYR is the default when the user states no currency; explicit SGD/S$ overrides it. Use null category/amount when genuinely unclear. Omit event_date_local unless the user or the receipt states a date/time; Alex stamps the message time automatically and never needs an invented clock time.

tools.name: confirm_expense
tools.description: Confirm or reject a pending money record after the user supplies missing information or approval.

tools.name: query_finances
tools.description: Read true ledger totals and matching transactions. Use ISO dates YYYY-MM-DD. scope may be all/family/private. source may be all/voice/receipt/text. For today/tomorrow/yesterday, resolve the runtime date and set both start_date and end_date. Natural drill-downs inherit the active canonical report period unless the current turn names a different period.

tools.name: list_pending_expenses
tools.description: List unresolved money records when the user is answering a previous clarification.

tools.name: correct_expense
tools.description: Correct an existing transaction append-only; the original remains auditable and is superseded.

tools.name: find_receipts
tools.description: Find original receipts by merchant/bank/reference, amount or date. scope may be all/family/private and is enforced by the backend.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Retrieve one original receipt previously found by find_receipts so Alex can send the actual image/document back.

tools.name: get_transaction_receipt
tools.description: Retrieve receipt evidence linked to one exact transaction. Never substitute a different/latest receipt when the transaction has no linked evidence.

tools.name: find_media
tools.description: Browse preserved original voice notes, images or documents the authenticated user is allowed to retrieve. Results are numbered for follow-up retrieval.

tools.name: get_media_original
tools.description: Retrieve one authorized original media object, including the original voice-note audio.

tools.name: list_pending_items
tools.description: List this owner's unresolved deferred items. Use kind=VOICE for unresolved voice notes. Results are numbered and use local time; internal IDs are intentionally hidden.

tools.name: resolve_pending_item
tools.description: Explicitly mark one owner's pending item resolved. Prefer the numbered choice from the latest pending list; item_id is used only for trusted quoted context.

tools.name: cancel_pending_item
tools.description: Explicitly cancel one owner's pending item without deleting its preserved provenance.

tools.name: save_item
tools.description: Explicitly remember something the user asked Alex to save. This is separate from automatic receipt retention.

tools.name: remember_knowledge
tools.description: Teach a persistent household fact or preference from an explicit remember/save/update request (typed or authorized current voice). Reuse the exact subject to update it; previous versions remain inspectable. Subject identifies the person/product/topic; topics specify when a preference applies (groceries, meals, replies). Relevant knowledge is recalled automatically across chats/restarts within current privacy scope. For an explicit grocery pricing preference, price_fallback=true enables remembered estimates when online prices are missing; false restricts automatic estimates to online data. Omit it for other preferences. This never changes permissions or creates reminders/actions. Use remember_product_price for a reusable per-pack estimate. Saved attachments still use save_item.

tools.name: remember_product_price
tools.description: Remember/update a user-provided MYR price PER PACK for later estimates, never an expense. Requires explicit typed remember/save/update intent and stated price or current receipt evidence. Preserve brand/range, size and pack count in product/pack_description; ask if unspecified, never invent. aliases are only shorthand the user explicitly teaches. Same product+pack+retailer updates history. observed_on is YYYY-MM-DD, omitted means today. Reused when online search has no verified match and in background grocery estimates; never claim it is live or in stock.

tools.name: recall_knowledge
tools.description: Read facts/preferences/product prices taught in chat, including existing saved text notes. Search by subject or browse without query; include_history shows previous taught versions. Scope is authenticated. For correction reuse the returned exact subject/product+pack+retailer; to forget use remove_saved_item with its returned item_id. No lookup of live store prices or expense records.

tools.name: search_saved_items
tools.description: Search or browse things the user explicitly asked Alex to save/remember within the authorized scope. Results contain metadata and exact item_ids, but no original attachments. For a request to find/show a specific saved picture or document, follow a unique matching result with get_saved_item in the same turn to retrieve the original. If matches are ambiguous, show the numbered choices and ask which one. Leave query empty to browse everything saved (newest first); kind may be picture, document or note (e.g. "what pictures did I save" -> kind=picture, no query). The user can follow a browsed list with "show 2".

tools.name: get_saved_item
tools.description: Retrieve one explicitly saved item, including its original attachment when it had one. Use the exact item_id returned by an authorized search or trusted selection; never invent an id. A unique result for a requested saved picture/document can be retrieved immediately after search_saved_items in the same turn.

tools.name: remove_saved_item
tools.description: Soft-remove an explicit saved-memory index while retaining original archived media evidence.

tools.name: resolve_numbered_choice
tools.description: Retrieve the exact original item from a numbered receipt, saved-item, media or pending-item list. This call also retrieves the original attachment when present; Alex sends it automatically, so no separate retrieval or discovery call is needed for that item. Reading a pending voice note does not resolve or cancel it. Use a supplied conversation-state selection_id and selection_kind when available; otherwise use the newest unexpired list.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a durable reminder. Include time_interpretation for natural date/time wording so the backend can validate its meaning and calculate the due time. Its source_text must quote original user wording; use ACTIVE_DRAFT only for the displayed pending reminder. An ISO due_local alone cannot supply a missing date or AM/PM. recipient accepts me/spouse/husband/wife/both or the configured household names. An explicitly named assignee is a DM reminder regardless of where the command was typed unless the user explicitly asks for the group. destination=group sends one Family Shared claimable group reminder.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List reminders with human-readable local times/states. Internal IDs are supplied only so a subsequent reminder action can target the exact record; never show them to the user.

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Complete/cancel/acknowledge/defer/reschedule/reopen a reminder. Use reminder_reference with the user's natural task words (for example 'balcony reminder') when no opaque reminder_id is already known. For 'reopen' use status='open'. For relative snooze pass snooze_minutes. For a naturally worded new_due_local, include a grounded time_interpretation with CURRENT_MESSAGE reference; preserve unresolved AM/PM or weekday ambiguity.

tools.name: reminder_history
tools.description: Read user-facing reminder history with local times and no database/provider internals.

tools.name: claim_reminder
tools.description: Explicitly take responsibility for one existing Family reminder. Prefer the authenticated quoted reminder ID; a unique natural name is allowed. Never creates a new reminder or changes its due time.

tools.name: handoff_reminder_claim
tools.description: Ask a household member such as Priya/spouse to accept your claimed Family Shared reminder. You remain claimant until they react to the DM request.

tools.name: release_reminder_claim
tools.description: Release/return a claimed Family reminder to the family group when the claimant says they cannot do it, wants to unclaim it, or wants to push/send/put it back to MCP Home/the group. Use reminder_reference when the task is named; if omitted, the backend acts only when this user has one unambiguous current claim. A fresh claimable group card is posted.

tools.name: nudge_reminder_claimant
tools.description: Privately remind the current claimant again when the original initiator explicitly asks. Ownership and unresolved state remain unchanged.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a first-class task with OPEN lifecycle state. A natural plan_name may be supplied instead of an opaque plan_id; Alex resolves exactly one accessible plan internally, so do not list plans first merely to obtain an id. New-write scope is resolved from the trusted user command. A reminder is never created implicitly.

tools.name: create_task_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder linked to one existing task. For a date-only task, reminder_mode must be heads_up or task_time; omit it to get a clarification instead of guessing. heads_up leaves the task due date unchanged; task_time also gives the task that exact due time.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List authorized tasks. Results are numbered and frozen for exact Show N follow-ups. status may be open, done, cancelled, or all.

tools.name: get_task_details
tools.description: Show one exact task's provenance, original instruction, due date/time, links and history using an exact id or natural task name.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Edit one task by exact id or natural name without changing lifecycle state. This never creates a reminder or rewrites the linked plan.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark one OPEN task DONE by exact id or natural name while preserving history and linked records.

tools.name: reopen_task
tools.description: Explicitly reopen one DONE task by exact id or natural name.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel one task by exact id or natural name without deleting linked plan/reminder records.

tools.name: set_goal
tools.description: Create or update a savings/planning goal using only values the user actually supplied.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: Read active goals available to the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_leave_balance
tools.description: Read the user's stored leave balance and as-of date. Never invent a balance when unknown.

tools.name: set_leave_balance
tools.description: Store/update leave balance only when the user explicitly provides the value.

tools.name: add_shopping_item
tools.description: Add an item to the shopping list. Shared household list is the default; use shared=false only when the user clearly asks for a private list.

tools.name: search_manjaku_prices
tools.description: Search current Manjaku Online listed prices using concise product/brand/pack keywords. Returns top matches, exact handles and variant IDs, MYR prices, online availability, links and local check time. Physical stores may differ. Cart/member/bundle discounts are unverified. An empty result is not proof of absence from the whole catalogue. No household records are changed.

tools.name: get_manjaku_product_price
tools.description: Refresh one Manjaku Online product using its exact handle and chosen variant_id from search_manjaku_prices. Require a size/variant choice when ambiguous. quantity counts sale units/packs. Listed-price subtotal excludes unverified cart/bundle/member discounts and delivery; report unavailable variants and stock shortages. Read-only, never a purchase.

tools.name: search_mydin_prices
tools.description: Search current MYDIN Online selling prices by product/brand/pack size. Public catalogue only. Returns exact product links, iSKUs, MYR selling prices, stock and check time. Present alternatives for ambiguous requests; never substitute a bulk tier price for one pack. No shopping or finance records are changed.

tools.name: get_mydin_product_price
tools.description: Refresh one MYDIN product by the exact iSKU from search_mydin_prices. quantity means whole packs; apply only qualifying quantity tiers and show insufficient stock. A configurable product needs a variant selection, not a guessed exact price. This is a read-only quote, never a purchase.

tools.name: list_shopping_items
tools.description: List groceries. Default items/quantities only; include_prices=true ONLY for a price/total request. Saved reference estimates label pending, ambiguous and stale prices. Scope is enforced by authenticated context. List adds/edits already queue quiet background pricing.

tools.name: grocery_monthly_summary
tools.description: Monthly grocery overview (YYYY-MM, defaults current local month). Returns historical list estimates separately from recorded actual groceries/kids-supplies spending. Never add estimates to actual expenses. Unknown prices remain unknown.

tools.name: select_grocery_product
tools.description: Bind an existing grocery item to the user's chosen exact MYDIN iSKU or Manjaku handle/variant from catalogue results. Use only after an explicit product/size choice; never guess for generic rice/milk/diapers. Refreshes and remembers that reference for background quantity updates; never records a purchase.

tools.name: update_shopping_item
tools.description: Rename/update one shopping item by exact id or natural item_name. Omitted status preserves state; explicit bought/purchased wording marks it purchased.

tools.name: ha_find_entities
tools.description: Find actual Home Assistant entity IDs by friendly name/entity id before answering or acting. Read-only.

tools.name: ha_get_state
tools.description: Read the current state and attributes of one exact Home Assistant entity.

tools.name: ha_home_summary
tools.description: Read Home Assistant states and produce a deterministic privacy-safe whole-home status summary.

tools.name: ha_home_report
tools.description: Render a deterministic local PNG whole-home status card and return it as a WhatsApp image attachment.

tools.name: ha_draft_automation
tools.description: Return a draft Home Assistant automation proposal only. It never deploys or edits HA configuration.

tools.name: ha_control
tools.description: Perform an explicitly requested low-risk Home Assistant action on lights, switches, fans, climate or media players, then verify state. Sensitive domains are rejected by the backend.

tools.name: set_work_roster
tools.description: Store the user's work roster. Roster means work schedule, not personal diary.

tools.name: list_work_roster
tools.description: Read only the authenticated user's work roster.

tools.name: set_leave_record
tools.description: Store or cancel ALEX's personal leave ledger. This is not an employer/HR submission. Use status=CANCELLED when the user asks to delete/cancel/remove a leave record. PLANNED/CONFIRMED do not count as historical absence; TAKEN materializes dated annual/medical leave into the work engine.

tools.name: list_leave_records
tools.description: Read the authenticated user's planned/confirmed/taken leave records.

tools.name: create_plan
tools.description: Create a draft life plan. New-write scope is resolved from the trusted user command; edits never move scope. If a date has no clock time, set time_known=false.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List accessible draft/locked plans.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Update/cancel a plan by exact id or natural plan_name. Existing scope is preserved.

tools.name: confirm_plan
tools.description: Confirm/finalise a plan by exact id or natural plan_name. Finalising alone keeps it in Plans; set add_to_diary=true only when the user explicitly asks to put it in the diary.

tools.name: share_plan
tools.description: Publish a private plan as a separate FAMILY_SHARED copy. Private notes are never copied automatically; provide shared_notes only when the owner explicitly wants those family-safe notes shared.

tools.name: add_diary_event
tools.description: Add a real-life diary commitment. If user supplied only a date, set time_known=false so same-day items become a heads-up rather than an invented midnight conflict. Exact work/Diary overlaps require user choice.

tools.name: resolve_diary_conflict
tools.description: Resolve a diary-vs-work conflict: 1=add event + PLANNED leave, 2=add event and keep clash, 3=cancel.

tools.name: resolve_latest_diary_conflict
tools.description: Resolve the latest unexpired owner-scoped diary conflict ticket. This is the safe handler for a later bare '1', '2' or '3' reply.

tools.name: update_diary_event
tools.description: Reschedule/cancel a diary event by exact id or natural title/date. If linked reminders exist, keep/shift/cancel must be explicit.

tools.name: get_agenda
tools.description: Combined read-only agenda. Use returned start_local/end_local/due_local fields for user-facing times; stored *_utc fields are internal evidence.

tools.name: get_agenda_range
tools.description: Resolve natural dates/ranges deterministically and return the combined agenda. Use returned local-time fields for replies.

tools.name: check_my_availability
tools.description: Check the owner's work-roster and Diary overlaps for a specific local interval, returning busy or no_conflict_found. start_local and end_local are ISO local datetimes; omitting end_local checks one hour from the start. Do not invent clock boundaries for vague periods such as 'evening'; ask for the interval when needed. Agenda tools list records and do not perform this interval conflict check. Owner-only private check, rejected in the family group and never publishable there.

tools.name: check_spouse_availability
tools.description: Check only shared spouse commitments. Private spouse roster/Diary is never read; if no shared clash exists, returns private_check_required.

tools.name: set_cashflow_baseline
tools.description: Store only the user's explicit guaranteed-income baseline. OT/variable/extra cash is excluded and stays unallocated unless instructed.

tools.name: get_cashflow_baseline
tools.description: Read the user's deterministic cash-flow baseline without recommending allowance changes.

tools.name: system_health
tools.description: Read sanitized Alex health/diagnostic facts: DB, failed messages, outbound queue, tool errors and usage. No secrets.

tools.name: recent_failures
tools.description: Explain recent observed Alex failures using local human timestamps and observed facts only.

tools.name: planning_create_goal
tools.description: Create an unlocked draft goal. baseline_monthly is optional and defaults to zero; never invent a contribution.

tools.name: planning_update_goal_target
tools.description: Change only an existing goal's target amount after explicit user instruction. This never creates a deadline or recurring contribution.

tools.name: planning_lock_goal
tools.description: Lock/activate one draft goal after explicit owner approval. Provide either goal_id from a prior result or its natural goal_name; Alex resolves names conservatively.

tools.name: planning_reopen_goal
tools.description: Reopen one eligible goal only after explicit owner instruction. goal_name may be used instead of an opaque id.

tools.name: planning_cancel_goal
tools.description: Cancel one goal while preserving target, funding and contribution history. Use the natural goal name when supplied; never ask the user to create a replacement goal.

tools.name: planning_set_period_target
tools.description: Set a one-period goal target such as 'RM100 is enough this month' without changing future recurring baseline. Natural goal_name is supported; omitted period means the current local month.

tools.name: planning_change_goal_baseline
tools.description: Change a recurring goal baseline prospectively. Natural goal_name is supported; earlier periods remain unchanged.

tools.name: planning_record_goal_contribution
tools.description: Record an actual goal contribution without changing its recurring plan. goal_name is accepted and omitted contribution_date means today locally.

tools.name: planning_goal_progress
tools.description: Read goal target, actual funding, remaining amount and recurring baseline. A scoped miss is returned as normal data so privacy-safe private search can be offered deterministically.

tools.name: planning_goal_deviation
tools.description: Compare actual contribution with the approved period plan. If actual_amount is omitted Alex computes actual contributions from stored records; omitted period means current local month.

tools.name: planning_record_cash
tools.description: Record salary/OT/bonus/refund/other cash. Variable cash starts UNALLOCATED. Omit event_date only when the user means the current local day.

tools.name: planning_compare_salary
tools.description: Compare an actual recorded salary payment with configured fixed salary. Omit cash_event_id to use the unique matching salary, or the latest salary when asking about the latest payment.

tools.name: planning_match_goal_alias
tools.description: Conservatively resolve a configured non-sensitive account alias to one authorized goal.

tools.name: planning_cash_status
tools.description: Read how much of one cash event is still unallocated. Natural event type/date/amount may be used instead of an opaque cash_event_id; ambiguous matches are never guessed.

tools.name: planning_allocate_cash_to_goal
tools.description: Allocate explicit extra cash to a goal only after the user instructs Alex. Natural cash-event and goal references are supported; ambiguous cash is never guessed.

tools.name: planning_create_cash_pool
tools.description: Create a stash/cash pool in the space selected by the current trusted command. Plain DM/group wording follows Family Shared; explicit private wording or emoji selects owner-private. Without opening_balance, a new pool is an empty zero-balance container using the built-in MYR currency default unless the user requests SGD; this records no funding or money movement. For creation with funding, pass the user's stated amount as opening_balance and require reliable evidence for MYR versus SGD; ask when that currency is missing. Creation + an explicitly requested opening balance are one atomic action.

tools.name: planning_list_cash_pools
tools.description: List active stash/cash pools visible in the current trusted read scope. Model scope arguments may narrow but never widen that boundary.

tools.name: planning_cash_pool_balance
tools.description: Read one authorized stash/cash-pool balance. A scoped miss is normal data, never a privacy-leaking tool error.

tools.name: planning_declare_cash_pool_balance
tools.description: Set a user-declared stash/cash-pool balance exactly. This is a balance fact, not income and not an automatic goal allocation.

tools.name: planning_record_cash_pool_spend
tools.description: Record spending from a stash/cash pool with optional category and funding-source note. This reduces the pool balance and does not create a second income record.

tools.name: planning_allocate_cash_to_pool
tools.description: Allocate explicit extra cash to a stash/pool after user instruction. Natural cash-event and pool references are supported; ambiguous matches are never guessed.

tools.name: planning_add_reserve
tools.description: Add an explicit monthly reserve/allowance to the baseline only because the user asked to reserve it.

tools.name: planning_update_reserve
tools.description: Change, enable or disable a reserve only after explicit owner instruction. Natural reserve_name is accepted instead of an opaque id.

tools.name: planning_list_reserves
tools.description: List authorized explicit planning reserves/allowances.

tools.name: planning_baseline
tools.description: Read deterministic baseline capacity. Raw private income is included in output only when the owner explicitly asks to reveal it.

tools.name: planning_income_outlook
tools.description: Read confirmed/expected/possible income. Omitted period means the current local month. OT remains possible/unknown until observed.

tools.name: planning_goal_projection
tools.description: Project a goal using its approved baseline only; natural goal_name is accepted and one-off extra contributions do not rewrite future baseline.

tools.name: planning_cash_outflow
tools.description: Read actual monthly cash outflow in separate sections: consumption/expenses, goal-savings contributions, and internal stash movements. Internal stash allocations are shown but excluded from the outflow total to prevent double counting.

tools.name: planning_cashflow
tools.description: Read a dated monthly forecast. Omitted period means the current local month. OT/variable income remains separate from guaranteed baseline.

tools.name: planning_brief
tools.description: Read a privacy-scoped baseline planning brief. Does not recommend allowance changes.

tools.name: planning_list_goals
tools.description: List authorized advanced goals and their current plan state.

tools.name: check_household_bill
tools.description: On-demand live home bill check. provider must be tnb or saj; call once for EACH requested provider. Stores a timestamped observation; no payment or expense is created. include_pdf=true ONLY when the user requests the PDF/original bill; TNB supports it, SAJ download remains unverified. analyse_pdf=true downloads and extracts untrusted statement text for a requested discrepancy review; it does not send a PDF unless include_pdf=true. Credentials/account must be configured privately in HA. Digi is screenshot-only; never use phone control or SMS. A failed source returns unavailable, not zero; bills_list only reads saved records and cannot replace a failed live check.

tools.name: record_digi_bill
tools.description: Save a readable current/quoted Digi Check Bill Details screenshot for husband or wife only. Read invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), invoice_amount (Current bill), outstanding (Total due), and due_date separately. Null for unreadable/absent balance/date; never guess. Verify whose number is shown against configured lines. This is a bill observation, NOT payment proof or an expense. Duplicate images do not duplicate bills. Do not ingest SMS.

tools.name: household_payments_summary
tools.description: Consolidate a local month (YYYY-MM) of TNB, SAJ, both Digi screenshots and recurring commitments, plus a separate grocery budget view. Refresh configured utilities on demand for the current month only, never send PDFs. Unknown or stale balances remain labelled. Do not add grocery estimates to actual expenses, or duplicate a provider bill as a recurring commitment.

tools.name: bills_list
tools.description: List recurring obligations. If period is omitted, materialize the current and next local month so 'coming up' does not falsely return empty.

tools.name: bills_match_payment
tools.description: Conservatively match payment/receipt evidence to exactly one recurring obligation. Amount alone never identifies a commitment; configured payee aliases, reference patterns or account fingerprint must match.

tools.name: bills_record_payment
tools.description: Record an actual payment against one exact obligation instance; supports partial payment.

tools.name: bills_defer
tools.description: Defer one exact obligation; history remains intact.

tools.name: bills_confirm_unpaid
tools.description: Mark one obligation explicitly confirmed unpaid. Missing evidence alone never means unpaid.

tools.name: work_import_profile
tools.description: Import this owner's explicit permanent private roster/overtime/leave profile from user-authored JSON. Values are validated and versioned locally; nothing is published to source control.

tools.name: work_schedule
tools.description: Read repeating roster and shift exceptions. OT is included only when its separate policy is configured.

tools.name: work_day
tools.description: Read a natural historical/current work-day brief without inventing attendance.

tools.name: work_record_event
tools.description: Record leave/MC/shift-swap or OT offered/pending/planned/worked/unavailable as a dated fact.

tools.name: work_ot_status
tools.description: Read explicit/default OT state; offered/pending are never treated as worked income.

tools.name: work_leave_balance
tools.description: Read a configured leave balance. Annual/medical reconcile later recorded leave events; childcare, wellness, hospitalisation and DOIL use the authoritative snapshot until updated.

tools.name: work_departure_plan
tools.description: Calculate leave-home/alarm candidates from real roster plus supplied travel duration. When travel_minutes is missing, return NEEDS_TRAVEL_ESTIMATE before reading the roster; no shift details are returned. Use work_schedule as well when the user also asks which shift they have. Never invent route time or create an alarm.

tools.name: asset_create
tools.description: Create household asset metadata such as appliance/warranty records.

tools.name: asset_update
tools.description: Edit an authorized asset, including warranty expiry, without replacing its linked receipt/manual/photo evidence.

tools.name: asset_link_document
tools.description: Link preserved receipt/warranty/manual/photo evidence to an authorized asset. Use asset_name instead of inventing an asset UUID. When linking the attachment on this exact message, omit evidence_ref and Alex binds the single preserved current media object automatically.

tools.name: asset_list
tools.description: List/filter authorized assets by natural name, brand, model, serial or note without widening the trusted privacy scope.

tools.name: warranty_expiring
tools.description: Find warranties expiring in a deterministic window. Omitted as_of_date means today locally; a vague 'warranties I should know about' uses the next 90 days.

tools.name: monitor_home_state
tools.description: Create a one-shot Home Assistant state monitor after an explicit request such as 'tell me when Hall AC turns on'. Resolve the exact entity first; this tool does not control the device.

tools.name: monitor_delegate
tools.description: Enable one explicitly requested monitor. Use GOAL_MONITOR for a savings goal, BILL_MONITOR for bills, OT_GOAL_TRACK for overtime savings, PRESENCE_REMINDER for presence, CUSTOM otherwise. Quiet by default.

tools.name: monitor_list
tools.description: List active user-authorized proactive monitoring delegations.

tools.name: monitor_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one explicit monitoring delegation.

tools.name: finance_report
tools.description:
Build a monthly finance report from actual ledger activity.

category/search are optional explicit filters. Omit both for the full
monthly report. Privacy scope is bounded by the trusted current command.

tools.name: report_snapshot
tools.description: Build the broader household/planning overview (goals, obligations, assets and leave). Use finance_report for actual monthly ledger activity.

tools.name: report_export
tools.description:
Export PDF/CSV/JSON from the active canonical report.

report_type may be finance or snapshot when the user explicitly names the
report. category/search/scope express explicit finance filters. Explicit
filters override active context; full_report clears active finance filters.
Supplying only a period preserves a matching active report context.

tools.name: report_payload
tools.description: Return a privacy-safe structured payload for a future Google Sheets or TV handoff; this tool never uploads externally.

tools.name: create_custom_ledger
tools.description: Create a custom private/shared tracker only when no specialist Alex engine (goal, stash, bill, task, etc.) fits better.

tools.name: list_custom_ledgers
tools.description: List custom trackers in the current privacy scope.

tools.name: add_custom_ledger_entry
tools.description: Add a custom-ledger entry. Money entries require explicit semantic kind: SPENDING, SAVINGS, TRANSFER or REFERENCE_ONLY; ambiguity returns a clarification and writes nothing.

tools.name: query_custom_ledger
tools.description: Read one custom ledger. Results are numbered and frozen for exact Show N follow-ups.

tools.name: close_custom_ledger
tools.description: Close one custom ledger while preserving all history.

tools.name: recall_discussion
tools.description: Recall a previously captured Family Shared Listening Mode discussion by natural topic words. Read-only; never turns discussion into a plan, task, reminder, diary entry or saved item automatically.

tools.name: list_discussions
tools.description: List genuine durable Ear discussions by topic, latest or pending actions. Freeze numbered order; never search unrelated saved notes.

tools.name: get_discussion
tools.description: Read one authorized Ear discussion: original capture, summary, decisions, action owners/status and audit history. No action is created.

tools.name: update_discussion
tools.description: Record explicit discussion decisions or status with history. Status: IDEA, DECISION_PENDING, ACTION_PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, ON_HOLD, DONE, CANCELLED. Read/acknowledged is NOT done. Never create a Task/Diary/Reminder without separate permission.

tools.name: update_discussion_action
tools.description: Create/update a discussion action ONLY from the user's explicit instruction. Use grounded action/owner IDs from returned records; clarify ambiguous action/owner. Never invent a deadline. Status DONE means actual completion, not acknowledgement. Does not create reminders/tasks/diary.

tools.name: link_discussion_action
